headline: Gemini Live is coming to your old Google Home devices with a premium subscription
summary: Google is bringing Gemini Live to first-gen Nest Hub and Home Mini devices with the July 23, 2026 update. Access requires a Google Home Premium subscription, but it also adds a crucial 15-minute conversational memory.
details: Google is expanding Gemini Live access to its first-gen Nest Hub and Home Mini devices with the July 23, 2026 update for Gemini for Home. Previously, these older devices were excluded due to aging hardware.
However, availability for these first-gen smart speakers and displays is paywalled behind the Google Home Premium subscription. Users can activate Gemini Live by saying, "Hey Google, let's chat."

A significant improvement in this update is the addition of a 15-minute conversational window across Gemini for Home. This addresses the previous lack of contextual memory on smart devices, a feature already present on PC and phone.

The AI assistant will now retain conversation context for 15 minutes, allowing for follow-up questions without needing to restart the interaction. For example, users can ask Gemini to adjust a thermostat by degrees incrementally.

Alongside Gemini for Home, Google is rolling out several improvements to the Google Home app. This includes clearer alerts for saving automations without starters and enhanced controls for smart blinds and window coverings.

For smart locks, the Google Home app will now remind users to manually change or remove passcodes when a member is removed or a home is left. Nest Cameras also receive updates for improved connection reliability, faster setup, and more accurate activity zones.
Additionally, Walmart's onn-branded Outdoor Camera and Floodlight Camera Hardwired are now integrated into the Gemini built-in program.
caption:

For smart locks, the Google Home app will now remind users to manually change or remove passcodes when a member is removed or a home is left. Nest Cameras also receive updates for improved connection reliability, faster setup, and more accurate activity zones.

Additionally, Walmart's onn-branded Outdoor Camera and Floodlight Camera Hardwired are now integrated into the Gemini built-in program.

headline: AI Skill writes GitHub Actions workflows with zero config errors
summary: This new AI Skill generates production-ready GitHub Actions YAML, enforcing 12 quality gates, 5 decision templates, and 3 mandatory security configurations to eliminate common errors and improve build efficiency.
details: A new AI Skill has been developed to automate the creation of GitHub Actions workflows, promising production-ready YAML with zero configuration errors. It integrates 12 quality gates, 5 decision templates, and 3 mandatory security configurations.

Hand-crafting GitHub Actions YAML is often error-prone, leading to missed configurations for permissions, action versions, caching, or concurrency. These omissions can result in slower builds, security vulnerabilities, or wasted development time.

The creator built this AI Skill as an "executable instruction set" rather than a vague prompt, forcing any AI agent to follow a strict pipeline. This ensures that essential configurations are mandatory, not optional, for generated workflows.

Every template within the skill enforces critical security and efficiency practices. This includes least-privilege permissions, robust concurrency control, and the use of SHA-1 pinned actions, with no exceptions.
The project is open-source, with the creator inviting stars on the repository and welcome contributions for new language templates and edge cases from the developer community.
